title: HDB Eligibility
text: Applicants must meet the applicable eligibility conditions before purchasing an HDB flat.

title: Using CPF to Buy a Home
text: CPF Ordinary Account savings may be used for eligible housing purchases subject to applicable CPF housing rules.

title: Minimum Occupation Period
text: Flat owners may be required to fulfil a Minimum Occupation Period before they can sell the flat.

title: Old CPF Housing Rule
text: This is an older housing rule used only for testing date-aware retrieval.

title: Updated CPF Housing Rule
text: This is the updated housing rule used to test whether retrieval prefers the applicable version.
